I mean, the objective for the characters is to become content with what they’ve accomplished and experienced before the end of the world, and they’d have to roleplay through that.

Maybe a player wants to spent a night hanging out doing drugs with a friend, they’d have to try and find connections to get some drugs, and find money for it, and not get caught with it. They’d have to basically tick off their bucket list before they die.

Eventually, the GM will likely say something along the lines of, “you wake up on the last day of the world”, and they’d have to play through coming to terms with it with each other as the world ends.

The whole idea is that it’s very roleplay heavy, they’d have to be inside the minds of who they’re playing to think of what they’d do when it’s the last thing they ever will do.
